bar.applies to: the pooled NATIVE cells AND each blind model (Phi-3.5-MoE, Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B, JetMoE-8B); deepseek-v2-lite in the pooled bar only, its own bar printed DESCRIPTIVE
bar.decided: owner, 2026-11-04: for every NEW blind test; registered here before any B3 page
bar.reason: the working-model bar is set against published accuracy for this problem, none of it pre-registered: TileSight (arXiv 2607.22432) 10.35% wMAPE on vLLM MoE configurations end to end (12.35% pooled MAPE on GEMM time); PipeWeave (ISCA 2026, arXiv 2601.14910) 6.0% on seen GPUs and 11.5% on unseen GPUs for Triton fused_moe, trained on 33,264 samples; NeuSight (ASPLOS 2025) 8.9% on unseen GPUs (~/reports/MoE kernel model prior art.md). A blind pass at rms <= 3%, every cell within 8% and |mean| <= 1.5% per model is a factor of 2 to 4 tighter than those mean errors and is registered before any page
bar.relation to the round-5 gate (stated pla: B3's earlier gate (round 4's, applied to round 5: G1 every held-out 128 G 1 mean within 1.0%, Mixtral-8x7B on C2's board too; G2 an estimated P(A) >= 0.5 at B2's bar 2% / 5% / 1%) was a MODEL-ROUND gate deciding whether to register B3 against B2's bar. Round 5 FAILED it (max held-out mean +2.39, tp2; P(A) 0.124) and that FAIL stands: this registration does not reverse it, and the model registered here is round 5's selected model exactly as it failed, not a model that passed (the align amendment tried after it is NOT adopted: the 'per-call risk' block). B3 is registered because the owner chose to go blind (ROUND5.md section 7's second option) under a new bar for every new blind test, the working-model bar, decided 2026-11-04 after round 5's numbers were known (disclosed in SEEN). Under the new bar the same estimate method gives A 0.428 (still under the old G2's 0.5; 0.30 to 0.40 with the per-call risk the B3 per-call check estimated) and a 1.5% G1 would still fail (tp2 +2.39, Mixtral-8x7B +1.77 / +2.01): the registration is made knowingly below both old thresholds. B2's own bar (2%, 5%, 1%) is printed beside every reading, DESCRIPTIVE: a B3 pass certifies at 3 / 8 / 1.5 only, never at B2's bar. A FAIL is final and spends Phi-3.5-MoE, Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B and JetMoE-8B (and deepseek-v2-lite) as blind models: after B3 they are SEEN whatever the verdict

per-call risk (disclosed, not modelled).statement: DISCLOSED RISK, NOT IN THE MODEL. Round 5's model prices every NATIVE block-scan call's per-call work (the align kernels, the silu_and_mul and moe_sum intercepts, launch gaps, the event overhead) as ONE constant, T0 + s_block = 43.23 - 7.07 = 36.16 us, fitted on the 2026-09-27 R3 Mixtral-8x7B pages at numel 256 to 1536 and 1710 MHz; it does NOT price the block-scan align by numel. B3's 84 cells span numel 1,024 (Phi 64g1) to 46,080 (Qwen1.5 128g16), every one on the block-scan path

the B3 per-call check (moe-kernels-work.the align kernel: the launch-floor traces (rentals 1 to 3, CUPTI, R3's old tile, 1710 MHz) put the two block-scan align kernels at 4.663 + 0.532 us per 1000 ids (9 points, numel 1,024 to 11,520, largest residual 0.20 us; 5.65 + 0.645 at 1410 if SM-clock bound), E-independent; over B3's numel span that is about 6 to 35 us against the model's constant budget, the fit measured only to 11,520

implied per-model error from the per-cal.reading: no B3 bar crossed by this term alone; with the estimate's common bias (+0.68%) JetMoE's expected mean goes to about +0.9 to +1.4% and Phi-3.5's to about +0.9%; with Phi's large-P w1 risk Phi's is about +1.9%, past the 1.5% |mean| bar. The +1% is ROUND5.md section 5's estimate that Phi 128g1 lands about 2 to 3% high if Phi behaves like tp2, spread over Phi's 30 cells (12 of the 30 are 128g1), as the per-call check's REPORT.md derives it

the B3 per-call check (moe-kernels-work.the small-kernel byte terms: the model prices silu_and_mul and moe_sum by their bytes at 3597.8 GB/s; B3's cells move 80 to 625 MB through them, past the 60 MiB L2 and beyond the range the check's trace fits were measured on (and the model's rate was fitted at): extrapolated, so the check read three rate cases (R0, R1, R2)
the B3 per-call check (moe-kernels-work.estimate A at the working-model bar with: 0.428 without them; 0.30 to 0.40 under the CAL anchor (byte-rate cases R0 0.2995, R1 0.3271, R2 0.399; JetMoE alone 0.52 to 0.67); 0.46 to 0.52 under the Mixtral anchor; 0.14 with decode's unexplained JetMoE +5 us and Qwen1.5 +4 us carried to prefill (an INFERENCE, a stress case)
the B3 per-call check (moe-kernels-work.verdict of the check: MARGINAL: the term alone crosses no bar, but it is unmodelled and lowers the estimate

per-call risk (disclosed, not modelled).the amendment tried, NOT ADOPTED (B3 v2,: price + slope x (numel - 1280) / 1000 us on every NATIVE block-scan cell at the launch-floor slope (0.6451 us per 1000 ids at 1410; T0 and s_block kept, the refit on the R3 fit pages differing by 0.196 us per call), on round 5's held-out cells: OLMoE +0.45 -> +2.01, Qwen2-57B -1.46 -> -1.09, Mixtral-8x7B +1.77 -> +1.80 (C2 +2.01 -> +2.04), Mixtral-8x22B +0.24 -> +0.25, tp2 +2.39 -> +2.44; rms of the five means 1.50 -> 1.70, pooled cell rms 1.64 -> 1.91; estimate A 0.428 -> 0.278. It worsened the held-out fit (OLMoE, the one CAL model with large numel, 8,192 to 32,768, moved +1.56 points: the frozen model's OLMoE agreement holds a compensation the align term removes, INFERENCE, not identified), so the owner did not adopt it (2026-11-04). No on-board align unit is run. The numbers are SEEN, from moe-kernels-work 2026-11-04 build-B3 DESIGN.v2.md and work-v2/amend.json, not recomputed here
per-call risk (disclosed, not modelled).consequence: the per-call error is a known, unmodelled risk of this registration. frozen.statement: The round-5 model (round5 ROUND5.md's selected variant: the STAG-CUT w1 byte law with W2 on w2, the K1 knee in the wall domain at round 4's SEEN constants, the clock form of F1, F1 'par'; 64x128 cells at v5'') is FROZEN as of this registration. No constant below is refitted, re-chosen or re-read from a B3 page; the on-board inputs are the sag par of the board's two f128 pages and the 64x128 sag par of its two f64w8 pages (MEASURED-ON-BOARD), each entered by the registered estimator. The reader refuses unless every work file below has its sha256, the frozen model reproduces the fingerprint on the 84 cells at A2's par and round 5's selected five-model table, and every repo module loaded is pinned. THE FREEZE IS TIED TO THE RENTAL'S COMMIT, as C2's and C4's: read_b3 takes the commit from the ledger's 'driver start: commit <sha>' line (gh200-driver/status, checked against session/commit.txt) and refuses unless git show <sha>:<path> equals the working copy for the registration JSON and text, the plan and every code_pins path, every code_pins path has its registered sha256, and every repo module loaded from the chain's repo (diag-A2 common.REPO) and from the reader's repo is a code_pins path with its registered bytes: a repo module is a git-tracked file under that repo, outside tests/ and any .venv, venv, site-packages or dist-packages directory, with an absolute __file__ (read_c2.repo_modules, C2's rule)

constants.w1 byte law STAG-CUT (no fitted constant: M4's staggered rank distance on w1 slab x events, the carried soft survival (C_B 72.52 MiB, beta_B 1.324), theta1 0.1967 in the first window; a later-wave w1 re-read whose fill reaches the 60 MiB L2 misses (r7.law5('STAG-CUT')); form declared after a SEEN diagnosis (DECLARED5.txt)
constants.w2 byte law W2: round 4's LS law: later-wave cross-group slab re-reads at D_eff = W_c dt / L from list scheduling (R 16, seed 20261027 x 1000 + i), sigma_gap 0.0375 (MEASURED-PERTURBED, in-sample for Mixtral-8x7B), the carried soft survival, the 60 MiB cut; the first window, in-group and A events M4's (v3 key, CARRIED)
constants.W_c: 264 = 132 SMs x 2 CTAs per SM at 128x128 (A2's census, C2's and C4's): MEASURED; B3's census gate holds it
constants.K1 knee (p_128, S0): (6.0, 2.75) k-steps: SEEN-FITTED (round 4, knee4.json K1 SEEN); no blind model is in any fit
constants.K1 rate: the A2 triad 3726.2 GB/s: MEASURED (rental A2)
constants.clock form of F1: fac_g = 1 + D_net(t0) / t0 on the floor side, D_net(t) = A (1 - exp(-t / tau)) - 6.11 (1 - exp(-t / 50 us)) us, t0 the GEMM's sag-free time (r6.v5_parts_clock): no new constant
constants.F1 (A, tau) at 128x128: MEASURED-ON-BOARD: 'par' of B3's OLMoE f128 and Mixtral-8x7B f128 fits (b3common.page_fit = refit4 r4.sag_page_fit = design-v5 sag.fit over sag.pts_of at 1410), A and tau averaged (r4.par)
constants.T0, c, bw, F4: 43.23 us, 202.548 ns, 3597.8 GB/s (asserted at import, the first-build trap at p 14), rho x 2: CARRIED; s_block -7.07 us, s_small 12.99 us: CARRIED (one per-call constant at every numel: the disclosed per-call risk)
constants.64x128 cells (Phi-3.5 64g1, 6 cells): v5'' as round 5 PART D priced them (k5.cell_ms(r, None, 5.75, par, par64) under r5.law3(): null knee, p_64 3.75 (SEEN-FITTED, a tail compensator per the design-v5 review), M4 / F3 bytes, F4 x 2) at the 64x128 sag par64 MEASURED-ON-BOARD: 'par' of B3's OLMoE f64w8 and Mixtral-8x7B f64w8 fits by the same estimator (gate b3sag64; the owner's choice; round 5 CARRIED A2's 30.37 us / 300 us, which the fingerprint keeps)
constants.JetMoE-8B 128g1 n2 PT (B2 index 72): PRICED: under W2 on w1 (round 4) its fixed point had two roots and the cell was UNPRICED; under STAG-CUT the guard refuses no blind cell (confirmed here: 84 of 84 priced at A2's, C2's and C4's pars). B3 scores all 84 cells; the unpriced rule stays: a cell the finalised model cannot price is listed and left out

cells.SHARED: each timed page also runs SHARED cells (B2's instrument); they carry no B3 prediction and are not scored

measured_on_board.sag (F1 at 128x128): B3-F: OLMoE f128 and Mixtral-8x7B f128 (128x128x64 w8 s3, G 64, treads 1 to 9, NATIVE, SHARED and PRIVATE: C2's and C4's units), fitted on the VM by gate b3sag; par enters every 128x128 prediction
measured_on_board.sag (F1 at 64x128): B3-F64: OLMoE f64w8 and Mixtral-8x7B f64w8 (64x128x64 w8 s3, G 64: A2's units), fitted on the VM by gate b3sag64; par64 enters the six Phi-3.5 64g1 predictions
measured_on_board.power: 700 W set and read back by C2's prelude (c2-power.env C2_POWER_W=700)
measured_on_board.lock: 1410 MHz locked and read back by the prelude (locks.env LOCK_PROBE_1410=held)
measured_on_board.G-BAND: A2's G-BAND on the two f128 pages (primary [0.975 L, L], else the fallback [0.959 L, L]); the band in force sets the counter band of the byte pages
measured_on_board.census: B3's compile-only census (label tb) of the blind models at both tiles
measured_on_board.sag drift (DESCRIPTIVE): B3-R: OLMoE f128 again at the end (label f128r, droppable), never priced

clock.band_which: fallback (registered: the primary band left joint_cF None)

stop_rule.where: every STOP is a driver stop before the first timed unit; a STOP ends the session (card reset, results pushed)
stop_rule.power: C2's prelude: nvidia-smi -pl 700 -sc 0, then enforced.power.limit and -q -d POWER's GPU-scope Current Power Limit both at 700 W within 1 W, polled every 2 s up to 30 s, else STOP; no fallback limit
stop_rule.lock: the prelude locks 1410, reads clocks.sm back (two tries) and STOPS when it does not hold
stop_rule.census: gate b3census (tileB3_gate.py census) after the census unit: B3's census equals A2's merged census on every compiled fact (tile_census_a2.FIELDS) for Phi-3.5-MoE, Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B and JetMoE-8B at 128x128x64w8s3 and 64x128x64w8s3, every merged entry present, no MMA path mismatch, else STOP; deepseek-v2-lite drifting is no STOP (its page is NOT SCORED)
stop_rule.band: A2's G-BAND (tileA2_gate.py band) after the two f128 pages, else STOP

sag-fit range.why: each clause brackets the SEEN boards with margin (A2, C2, C4 per page: A 29.65 to 67.55 us, tau 300 to 650 us, rms 4.02 to 13.01 us, 54 points; ratio 1.52 to 1.59; par A 41.59 to 54.25): a fit outside it is an instrument or board fault, not a sag the frozen clock form was read at. design-v5's rms <= 10 us would have stopped every SEEN board (Mixtral's pages 10.25 to 13.01), so it is 20 here

64x128 sag-fit range.gate: b3sag64 (tileB3_gate.py sag64) after the two f64w8 pages

clock clause.rule: r6common.clock_rule on each f64w8 page under A2's scoring rules in the band in force (score_floor_a2.choose_band on the f128 pages, as G-BAND): lock_gate.check_page PASS and at least cells_in_band_min of 27 cells in band; the rule B3's byte pages are read under
clock clause.why this and not A2's G-64: G-64 asks that a 64x128 CONV calibration (joint_cF) exists in the band, a fit B3's pricing never reads; the clock rule checks what the sag reading needs, that the page ran at the lock and its cells' clocks sit in the band, per cell. Every cell in band is not asked: the sag itself takes cells under the band (A2's f64w8 26 and 22 of 27 in band; the f128 pages on A2, C2, C4 17 to 24)

64x128 sag-fit range.why: each clause brackets A2's f64w8 pages (the only SEEN board: A 24.79 and 35.94 us, tau 275 and 325 us, rms 3.32 and 7.62 us, 54 points, ratio 1.42, par A 30.37) with the 128x128 range's margins; every clause fails on a NaN

finalisation.before the rental: this registration: the frozen code and constants, the 84 predictions at A2's, C2's and C4's 128x128 pars and A2's 64x128 par, the fingerprint (A2's par, A2's CARRIED 64x128 sag), the stakes and rivals
finalisation.on the rental: gates b3sag and b3sag64 fit the four sag pages, apply the registered ranges and write par, par64 and every page's sha256 to the ledger (gate-b3sag-1410.json, gate-b3sag64-1410.json) before the first timed unit
finalisation.after the rental, before any blind page: read_b3.py finalise: the freeze, the commit and the pins; the fingerprint; both sag gate records PASS; every fit recomputed by the frozen chain (r4.sag_page_fit; its design-v5 sag.fit on the f64w8 pages) and by b3common.page_fit, equal to each other; each par equal to its gate record's to a relative 1e-9 (b3common.PAR_RTOL: the record is computed on the GH200, the check on the laptop, the same estimator on the same page bytes, so the tolerance absorbs float summation order only) and every page sha256 equal; the f64w8 clock clause recomputed; the 84 cells priced at par and par64; an audit hook refuses the run if any path under the B3 tree in a gaps-* directory, or naming a blind model (except the compile-only census), is opened. Its file scripts/scoring/tileB3/b3.predictions.json (sorted keys) is committed by the owner before `score` runs; `score` re-finalises and refuses unless the file equals the finalised file (a content check, not a git check). No argument sets any constant

E1-TILE (the registered verdict).statistic: e = T_model / T_meas - 1 per valid NATIVE cell (all six labels), the finalised prediction; valid as B2: tcommon.timed_page (G5 provenance, r7-median-run3 rebuild, the view, the page's tile) and tcommon.valid_cells (6 of 9 clean, G2 host on the finalised prediction and the timer flag, G4 cell clock >= 1405 MHz)
E1-TILE (the registered verdict).rule: HOLDS iff the POOLED NATIVE cells AND each blind model's meet rms <= 3%, every cell within 8%, |mean| <= 1.5% (b3common.e1_rule at BAR), in ALL and in CLEAN; the registered verdict is rental 2's rule 3 over the two views (a disagreement reads INCONCLUSIVE), as B2's scorer combines them
E1-TILE (the registered verdict).deepseek-v2-lite: in the pooled bar; its own bar printed DESCRIPTIVE (one page, never CERTIFIED); dropped (dsv) or census-drifted, it leaves the pool
E1-TILE (the registered verdict).a blind model with no valid cell: E1-TILE reads NOT SCORED (incomplete), not FAILS, unless the pool or another blind model fails
E1-TILE (the registered verdict).G3: rental 7's TOST on uniform minus balanced, as r5common.g3_rule reads it: homogeneous and failing, every histogram cell is voided and E1-TILE reads NOT SCORED (printed DESCRIPTIVE); heterogeneous, the failing strata's non-balanced cells are voided and the verdict is read WITH those voids; the bar without them is printed beside, DESCRIPTIVE. This replaces score_tileB.py's all-strata-only void for B3 (the design-v5 review's MAJOR 9: the verdict view named before any page)
E1-TILE (the registered verdict).validity: NOT SCORED unless the board reads valid (c2-power.env C2_POWER_W=700, LOCK_PROBE_1410=held, G-BAND PASS) and all three B3 gate records (census, sag, sag64) read PASS

tests.certification: a blind model is CERTIFIED when E1-TILE HOLDS, its own bar holds in CLEAN and at least 2 of its pages are in CLEAN (Phi-3.5 3 pages, Qwen1.5 2, JetMoE 2: every one nodrop); a model left with one page has its bar scored and is NOT CERTIFIED
DESCRIPTIVE beside (no verdict): B2's bar (2%, 5%, 1%) on the same cells
the bar without G3's per-stratum voids
rivals: v5'', round 4's frozen model, v4 at A2's selections (e on the same cells)
splits: 128 G 16, 128 G 1, 64 G 1, per model and class
B-BYTES (predicted reads against counted, per GEMM; B2's byte bar) and E2-TILE (the frozen model's time from counted bytes, 128x128 cells)
the sag drift (f128r against the early OLMoE fit)

certification.scope: A B3 pass certifies the frozen round-5 model's NATIVE time at vLLM's two reachable wgmma tiles (128x128x64 w8 s3 at G 1 and G 16, 64x128x64 w8 s3 at G 1; prefill) on the GH200 at 1410 MHz and 700 W, on the registered cells only (B2's 84: Phi-3.5-MoE 30, Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B 30, JetMoE-8B 18, deepseek-v2-lite 6 pooled), at the working-model bar (rms <= 3%, every cell within 8%, |mean| <= 1.5%), each CERTIFIED model named. It does not certify B2's bar, any other lock, power limit, tile, card or model, decode, SHARED cells, the byte law (B-BYTES is DESCRIPTIVE), the per-call constant at other numel, or either sag on another board

pass_estimate.method: ESTIMATE, by the knee round's method (read_c4.pass_estimates on five means): read_c2.power (diag-v5 power5's, verbatim, the bar an argument: b3common.power) on B2's 84 registered NATIVE cells under B2's noise model (cell 0.6%, bytes 1.75% x dlnT/dlnB, page 0.18%, board 0.26%), R 200,000, seed 20261022; the held-out bias and spread from round 5's five held-out means (OLMoE +0.45, Qwen2-57B -1.46, Mixtral-8x7B +1.77, Mixtral-8x22B +0.24, tp2 +2.39): A = power(the mean of the five b = -ln(1 + e), their SD), B = power(0, their RMS), D = A with Mixtral-8x7B's G 1 set aside
pass_estimate.with the per-call risk (the B3 per-call: A 0.30 to 0.40 at the working-model bar under the check's CAL anchor (0.46 to 0.52 under its Mixtral anchor; 0.14 in its decode-residual stress case)
pass_estimate.reading: P(E1-TILE HOLDS) is about 0.43 (A), 0.57 (B), 0.47 (D) at the working-model bar, against 0.12 to 0.19 at B2's. Each blind model alone passes about 0.73 to 0.79 of draws under A; the binding clause is the per-model |mean| <= 1.5% against a model-specific SD of about 1.5%. The estimate does not carry the per-call risk (A 0.30 to 0.40 with it, the 'per-call risk' block), the large-P w1 model-choice uncertainty on Phi-3.5 128g1 (ROUND5.md section 5) beyond what the five means' spread holds, or the board's 64x128 sag

after: OWNER DECISIONS 2026-11-04 (registered): every NEW blind test at the working-model bar; B3 goes blind with round 5's selected model as frozen here, without the align amendment (tried offline, worsened the held-out fit, not adopted), with the per-call risk disclosed and the 64x128 sag measured on B3's board. A FAIL is final: it spends the four blind models and changes no earlier verdict. Every registered verdict already scored stands (A2's E1-CAL FAIL, C2's, C4's readings, round 5's gate FAIL)
